The title commemorates the past karmic aspirations and attainments of a thera associated with undertaking the five precepts (*pañcasīla*). According to SuttaCentral, five modern translations in five languages are available for this text [SuttaCentral].

Furthermore, recurring formulaic verse sequences are shared with neighboring and other Apadāna poems, notably the *Tisaraṇagamaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 25), *Upavānattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 24), *Subhūtittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 23), and *Dhūpadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 28) [DharmaNexus].
